frontend._doc: Each build runs on Windows through cmd.exe when one of its triggers changed. A changed path under resources/ that matches no specific build runs every build. Outputs are gitignored, so they are copied as include_after_build.

qa.notes: Never production (*.zaiko.io). Turnstile is non-blocking on dev. Headed browser only.
qa._pages_doc: Named pages a scenario may refer to as page:<name>; {placeholders} are filled from a recipe result or the scenario. Filled in from the route files.
qa.browser_config_doc: Pass as --config on every playwright-cli open. Its Chrome flag --host-resolver-rules pins *.zaiko.dev to the dev box, because the public wildcard DNS sends microsite subdomains such as qa-live.zaiko.dev to another dev stack (3.166.x.x, AWS) whose build differs from the box. zaiko.dev, creators.zaiko.dev and cdn.zaiko.dev already point at the box.

zaikolive._doc: Fill dev.ssh when the repo is cloned here; the directory name must match this key. Per your note: the frontend build is `npm run dev`, then the public folder is synced.
